description: Create one reusable three-minute walkthrough for an owner, funder, or agent builder. Start with one expensive person-dependent workflow, show the owner mission and human-only decisions in the graph, show Aimparency selecting and delegating a bounded task, show external evidence and real costs returning, then zoom out to the strategy-agent layer for a future of dramatically more capable specialist agents. Clearly distinguish the working system, the one-month experiment, and the longer-term vision. Do not imply a customer, A2A deployment, payment, or autonomous company already exists.

status.comment: The three-minute walkthrough, one-sentence category, truth labels, audience-specific asks, and evidence checklist are drafted and internally checked; awaiting Felix's narrative/visual acceptance.

reflection: Created meta/three-minute-moonshot-walkthrough.md as the detail artifact for this graph aim. It provides a timed survival→graph→bounded delegation→external evidence→moonshot arc, explicitly labels what works now versus what is being tested versus the A2A direction, and avoids claiming customers, revenue, or deployed interoperability. Following Felix's correction, the one-month schedule itself is now represented as four Aimparency phases with existing aims committed to each; Markdown remains only for the timed script detail.
